en: Colorized vintage postcard view over a residential hillside area with large villas and houses surrounded by trees and gardens. In the background are wooded hills with scattered buildings on the slopes. The title "Radebeul-Oberlößnitz" appears in red at the top, and smaller red text is printed in the lower right corner. The image has the typical tinted style of early 20th‑century picture postcards.
